patch.value: Review and audit passes are identified by date and theme, never by sequential numbers

Standing governance convention: every review, audit, organization, or planning pass recorded in the tracker is named by ISO date plus a descriptive theme. Sequential pass numbering (for example 'audit pass #99' or 'review #17') is prohibited in item titles, bodies, comments, notes, learnings, docs, and linked evidence.

Convention is recorded on the living roadmap pm-doxj; every future pass is identified by ISO date and descriptive theme; no new sequential pass numbers appear in any tracker surface or doc; historical numbered references remain unaltered as immutable record; enforcement rides the existing tracker data-quality ratchet pm-kpftft
Keep pass identifiers self-describing, sortable, and safe under thousands of concurrent agents and multi-branch merges
Date+theme identifiers carry their own context, cannot collide across branches or harnesses, and need no global counter coordination

An explicit maintainer directive prohibits numbered audit runs; the tracker already mixes both styles (numbered review #12/#13/#15/#16 and pass 91 versus unnumbered date+theme passes since 2026-07-25) with no recorded governing decision

message: Decision recorded from explicit maintainer directive; duplicate-checked against full corpus (keyword search + dedupe-audit show no existing convention item)
